subject: general
question: Manisha's sister Sakshi is the wife of Subham. Subham is the brother of Darshan. Akash, the son of Manisha, has a sister Rekha who is the daughter of Darshan. Rekha's father Darshan’s mother is Saloni. How is Saloni related to Sakshi?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02115387156e02316bfb1dd95fcf89921e131b2ebba984f145a37f06b22e5d9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38f75362b6e1f8ce42204233fdf85b5af1e34669f6c901f0a019aeb751b53afd.png] 

Clearly, Saloni is mother-in-law of Sakshi.

Hence, ‘**Mother-in-law**’ is the correct answer.
